findings.description: AC-004 checks (a) first: 'no window raised and focused element still the one noted'. When the noted element already is the remembered input (common: the app kept focus in it) and range restore/verify fails, (a) inserts into that input at an unverified caret, while (b), the Story 3 diagram, FR-004 and the caret decision say paste nothing.
findings.suggestion: State in AC-004 that (b)'s 'remembered input focused, range not restored or verified' takes precedence over (a), or exclude from (a) the case where the focused element is the remembered input.

findings.description: Range unread at start, or step (1) failing at insertion, yields the bubble even when no attempt was made and the user never left the input, though Story 3 promises today's behavior when the attempt changed nothing. findings.suggestion: Confirm this regression vs dev is intended, or do not remember an input whose range is unreadable so 006 applies; align the Story 3 wording either way.

findings.description: A focus or range write (AX set or UIA SetFocus/Select) that times out on Handy's side may still be applied by the target later. Counting it as 'failed' can let (a) pick the 006 path while focus moves into the remembered input afterwards, pasting at an unverified caret.
findings.suggestion: Treat a timed-out or late write in steps (2)-(4) as 'attempt changed something' (AC-004 b), and add this case to SC-002 fault injection.
